notes.title: Version 1.07 is Out!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We've been pretty quiet lately, working hard on improving the game and porting it to more platforms (more on this soon). In the meantime we wanted to update the desktop builds with some great improvements.
Updates include: 

    Cloud saving!
    Various puzzle improvements across all levels
    Enhanced control scheme (great for speedrunners!)

Also, Localization and more updates coming soon!

Also, we're extremely honored to take part in the latest Humble Eye-Candy Bundle! More on this amazing bundle here!

Keep deleting & growing,
-- itay and the Mushroom 11 team

"Mushroom 11 stands out by being a brilliantly smart idea, superbly executed, and constantly rewarding to play." - Rock, Paper, Shotgun

2015 has been an exciting year for us, with plenty of fan and media recognition following our October launch, with much exciting news following soon. We hope you all have a great 2016!

notes.title: Version 1.03 is Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
We've been working hard in the last couple of weeks on fixing some of the reported issues, or things we felt needed some more attention.

- Difficulty: various changes focusing on maintaining the level of challenge that's expected from Mushroom 11, but with minimal frustration
- Keyboard Controls: allow custom assigning of alternate key controls
- Savegames: a few fixes to handle consistency and disconnect issues
- Several small performance and stability fixes

Thanks for your feedback and support! <3
-- itay

notes.title: New Update v1.02!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We wanted to do a bit of an overhaul on the difficulty curve in the game. The latest update includes many small changes to puzzles across the game, focusing on smoothing out the difficulty ramp up, with special attention to chapter 5.

More importantly, we've made a major change in the way pickups (the brightly colored creatures) are saved. Instead of registering them in the next checkpoint, they are now registered immediately. No need anymore to go back and grab them after failing a puzzle!

Thank you for your feedback and support!
-- itay and the Mushroom 11 team

notes.title: Mushroom 11 among most anticipated fall releases
notes.content:
We are proud to be among The Verge's most anticipated fall releases! 
"It’s easy to learn, immediately enjoyable to play, and the green goo is adorable — despite having no discernible emotions. Plus, few people have heard about Mushroom 11, so when it becomes a surprise hit, you can grin and say you played it before it was cool."
- The Verge
